statement: 1 ≤ n → ∀ q : ℝ, dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → YuiContent (q + 1) δ (YuiCylinder E) = 0
proof:
intro hn q hq δ hδ
have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
let r : ℝ := min 1 (δ / Real.sqrt 2)
have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hδ hs)
have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
have hrs : Real.sqrt 2 * r ≤ δ := by
  have h : r ≤ δ / Real.sqrt 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have := (le_div_iff₀ hs).1 h
  nlinarith
let C : ℝ := 2 * (Real.sqrt 2) ^ (q + 1)
have hC : 0 < C := mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs _)
have hbound : ∀ j : ℕ,
    YuiContent (q + 1) δ (YuiCylinder E) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1))) := by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hcost⟩ := h_T008 hn q hq r (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) hr hr1 (by positivity)
  have hcover : YuiCover δ (YuiCylinder E) W := by
    refine ⟨hW.1, fun i => (hW.2 i).trans ?_⟩
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hrs
  exact (@yui_aux_0002 n E h_T002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T008 (q + 1) δ W hcover).trans hcost.le
have hlim := @yui_aux_0003 n E h_T002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T008 C
exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' hlim hbound) (by positivity)

        0 < a →
          YuiMeasure a A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) A ∧
            (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ∞) ∧
                (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧ (YuiMeasure a A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)), 0 ≤ dimH A) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (A B : Set (YuiEucl k)), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B) ∧
          ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →
    ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YuiContent s δ E < ∞) →
      (n = 0 → dimH (YuiCylinder E) ≤ dimH E + 1) →
        (1 ≤ n →
            ∀ (q : ℝ),
              dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
                ∀ (r ε : ℝ),
                  0 < r →
                    r ≤ 1 →
                      0 < ε →
                        ∃ W,
                          YuiCover (√2 * r) (YuiCylinder E) W ∧
                            YuiCost (q + 1) W < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * √2 ^ (q + 1) * ε)) →
          1 ≤ n → ∀ (q : ℝ), dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → YuiContent (q + 1) δ (YuiCylinder E) = 0
